mentions.name: Linux-based machinery controller platform
mentions.description: A Linux-based controller platform for agricultural, water treatment, and fertigation machinery. It extends to any number of analog/digital inputs and outputs (AO, AI, DI, DO) to control machines, replacing expensive PLC + SCADA setups with a cost-effective connected solution (Go backend, React UI).
mentions.problem: Traditionally these machines use a PLC connected to SCADA and the Internet, which is expensive, leaving smaller customers unable to afford connectivity inside each machine.
mentions.source_excerpt: We have built Linux based controller that can extend into any number of AO, AI, DI, DO inputs and control the machine. It's very cost effective, and unlocks a lower bottom of the market that before didn't even dream about installing connectivity inside each machine.
mentions.author: artificialprint
